title: Microsoft Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Moniker Link)
description: An attacker could bypass Office Protected View and execute arbitrary code via a specially crafted mail containing a malicious moniker link.
remediation_plan: Deploy Microsoft security bulletin KB5035349 to all workstation and mail relay endpoints.

title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection in GlobalProtect Gateway
description: A command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.
remediation_plan: Upgrade PAN-OS to 11.1.2-h3 and apply threat prevention signature 95187.

title: OpenSSH regreSSHion Signal Handler Race Condition Remote Code Execution
description: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server (sshd) allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
remediation_plan: Update openssh-server to version 9.8p1 or set LoginGraceTime to 0 in sshd_config.

title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Denial of Service Vulnerability
description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a client to reset rapid consecutive streams using RST_STREAM frames, overwhelming web servers and causing severe DoS.
remediation_plan: Configure HTTP/2 stream rate-limiting in reverse proxies and patch load balancers.

title: Jenkins CLI Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
description: Jenkins uses args4j parser in CLI commands which replaces '@' followed by a file path with file contents, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary server files.
remediation_plan: Upgrade Jenkins core to 2.442 and disable unauthenticated Jenkins CLI access.

title: JetBrains TeamCity Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
description: An authentication bypass in TeamCity web server enables unauthenticated remote attackers to perform administrative actions and achieve RCE.
remediation_plan: Apply JetBrains security release 2023.11.4 and rotate build agent tokens.

title: PHP CGI Argument Injection Vulnerability on Windows
description: Bypass of Best Fit encoding mapping in Windows-based PHP installations allows remote command execution via query string character injection.
remediation_plan: Update PHP to 8.3.8 and migrate legacy CGI handlers to FastCGI.

title: Windows Remote Desktop Licensing Service Remote Code Execution
description: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Remote Desktop Licensing Service allows unauthenticated network attackers to achieve code execution.
remediation_plan: Install Microsoft cumulative security update on domain controllers and restrict RPC port exposure.

title: libwebp Heap Buffer Overflow in Image Decoding Pipeline
description: Heap buffer overflow in WebP lossless encoding decoding allows code execution upon rendering crafted image uploads.
remediation_plan: Update system libwebp packages to >= 1.3.2 across web portal nodes.

title: runc Container Escape via File Descriptor Leak (Leaky Vessels)
description: In runc through 1.1.11, an attacker can specify a working directory that leaks an internal host file descriptor leading to container breakout.
remediation_plan: Upgrade container runtime engines to runc 1.1.12+ on Kubernetes payment and core nodes.

title: XZ Utils Malicious Backdoor Injection in liblzma
description: Upstream source tarballs of XZ Utils contained obfuscated backdoor code modifying OpenSSH authentication functions in build stages.
remediation_plan: Pin xz-utils to verified 5.4.x packages and audit cryptographic checksums.

title: Ejecución remota de código (RCE) por escritura fuera de límites en pasarela API de pagos
description: Vulnerabilidad crítica de escritura fuera de límites (Out-of-bounds Write) en el motor TLS/HTTP de la API de pagos alojada por HostingSur S.L., permitiendo ejecución de código arbitrario mediante peticiones HTTP manipuladas sin autenticación previa.
remediation_plan: Aplicar parche de emergencia en el cluster de API de pagos de HostingSur S.L., activar reglas WAF de inspección profunda y condicionar la renovación del contrato de marzo a la verificación del parche.

title: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance Denial of Service Vulnerability
description: A vulnerability in the web server management engine of Cisco ASA software allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to reload the device causing DoS.
remediation_plan: Apply Cisco ASA Software release 9.18.4.22 during scheduled maintenance window.

title: cURL SOCKS5 Heap Buffer Overflow
description: A heap-based buffer overflow in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake protocol in curl allows remote code execution or crash when hostnames exceed 255 bytes.
remediation_plan: Update curl and libcurl to 8.4.0 across all Debian/Ubuntu base images.

title: Spring Framework URL Parsing Open Redirect and SSRF
description: Applications using UriComponentsBuilder in Spring Framework may parse externally provided host information insecurely, enabling SSRF attacks.
remediation_plan: Upgrade spring-web to 6.1.4 and validate redirect targets against an allowlist.

title: Apache Commons Compress Denial of Service via Pack200
description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits in Apache Commons Compress allows an attacker to cause an OutOfMemoryError using crafted pack200 archive files.
remediation_plan: Update org.apache.commons:commons-compress dependency to 1.26.0 in Maven pom.xml.

title: go-jose Malicious JWE Compression Denial of Service (Token Zip Bomb)
description: An attacker can send a high-compression JSON Web Encryption token that exhausts server CPU/memory upon decompression.
remediation_plan: Update go-jose module to v3.0.3 and enforce 256KB JWE payload decompression cap.

title: Golang net/netip Unexpected IPv4-Mapped IPv6 Address Parsing Inconsistency
description: IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses were parsed inconsistently in IsPrivate/IsLoopback checks, which could cause ACL bypasses.
remediation_plan: Recompile Go microservices with Go runtime 1.22.4.

title: MiniZip Integer Overflow in zlib Contrib Directory
description: MiniZip in zlib contains an integer overflow and resultant heap buffer overflow through a large uncompressed file size parameter.
remediation_plan: Replace legacy minizip archive routines with standard Java/ OS zip libraries.

title: Spring Framework Path Traversal via Static Resource Handlers
description: Applications serving static resources through Spring WebMvc could expose internal files if configured with custom resource chain resolvers.
remediation_plan: Update Spring Framework to 6.1.13 and audit WebMvcConfigurer resource handlers.
